cards.front: A 23-year-old has flat, moist, grey-white plaques on the vulva and perianal skin, a non-itchy rash on her palms and soles, and enlarged inguinal nodes. The genital lesions are [___].
cards.context:
Broad, flat, moist papules in warm, moist sites are condylomata lata of secondary syphilis. They teem with treponemes and are highly infectious.

The raised, cauliflower-like warts of HPV are condylomata acuminata. A palm and sole rash points to syphilis.
